F04_NOTE: No condition-number threshold, ridge, pinv, lstsq, or regularization was introduced; no such guard was preregistered. Exact-singular and nonfinite coefficients remain MARKET_06_INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION.

F01_bar_end_semantics.defect: Feature-side lookups were keyed by the FEATURE_CUTOFF open_time, selecting the bar [E, E+5m) whose available_at is T, violating the frozen prereg no_lookahead.feature_information = 'available_at <= FEATURE_CUTOFF only' with perp_leg.available_at = bar_end_exclusive.
F01_bar_end_semantics.repair: Single explicit mapping bar_open_for_close_at(U) = U - BAR_MS, plus an explicit temporal API (get_perp_bar_ending_at / get_spot_close_ending_at for features and BTC state, get_perp_bar_opening_at for entry/outcome). No call site derives the mapping independently.

F03_integrity_vs_row_ineligibility.repair: Typed Market06RowIneligible. Only preregistered eligibility conditions (genuinely absent bar, BTC_RET_24H == 0 exactly, MAD_T <= 0, RV <= 0 or nonfinite) drop a row. Source corruption raises Market06IncompleteExecution and aborts canonical execution.

F05_arm_lifecycle.defect: execution_authorization_artifact_exists() was constant False; require_execution_authorization() raised on every path; reconstruct_canonical_dataset() raised unconditionally; retained bytes were permanently unparseable; assert_no_arm_or_result() made the ARM's presence BREAK authority verification; runner ended its success path in an unreachable RuntimeError.
F05_arm_lifecycle.repair: Permit architecture. A tracked ARM authenticated from immutable Git objects mints an opaque ExecutionPermit. No scientific module needs editing to arm.

F06_global_reconstruction.repair: market_06_canonical_reconstruction enforces exact object inventory, per-object SHA256/byte-length, GLOBAL cross-object timestamp uniqueness, 5m alignment, exact first/last timestamp, exact count 315648, no missing timestamps, and Binance/OKX timestamp-set equality. No interpolation, forward-fill, or deduplication.

F07_git_object_authority.repair: ARM/reservation/RESULT existence and bytes are read from immutable Git objects. Working-tree presence never authorizes; it is output staging only.

F08_git_hardening.repair: market_06_git_authority strips GIT_* redirection, disables replace refs, neutralizes system/global config, resolves the git executable, and proves object existence with cat-file -e <oid>^{type} rather than trusting a rev-parse echo.

F09_adversarial_temporal_tests.repair: Tautological cutoff fixtures replaced. Every fixture represents open_time, bar_end, FEATURE_CUTOFF and T separately, asserts exact open-times, and a malicious extreme bar at [E, E+5m) must not move any feature.
